summary: Matternet, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement updating its Form S-1 resale registration for up to 51,590,925 shares held by selling stockholders. The shares stem from a May 22, 2026 de-SPAC reverse merger with Legacy Matternet, concurrent PIPE and bridge-note conversions, and related warrants. No new securities are offered by the company, which receives no proceeds except upon cash warrant exercises. Shares trade OTCQB under MTTN. This is a routine resale registration update, not a special situation; watch for resale overhang and warrant exercises.
